purpose: Provisional subject clusters and distances for roadmaps whose evidence-based classification (research/blueprint/classify) has not finished. scripts/classification.py uses an entry only when no classification result exists. Distances use the classification scale: 0 means the targets can be stated and proved from Mathlib now, 10 means several research-level theories must be built first.

SpecialValuesBirchTate.reason: Zeta special values against K2 of rings of integers; needs Iwasawa main conjectures and étale K-theory.

StableHomotopyKTheory.reason: Classifying spaces, plus construction and spectra; Mathlib has simplicial sets but no spectra or group completion.

TorsionCohomologyInfrastructure.reason: Torsion in the cohomology of arithmetic groups and locally symmetric spaces.

TropicalAndBerkovichArithmetic.reason: Berkovich analytification and skeleta; no nonarchimedean analytic spaces in Mathlib.

VStackSheavesAndLisseCategories.reason: Sheaves on Artin v-stacks for Fargues–Scholze geometrization, over diamonds and condensed coefficients.

VectorBundlesAndIsocrystals.reason: Isocrystals and bundles on the Fargues–Fontaine curve; needs the curve and Banach–Colmez spaces.

WeightsInEtaleCohomology.reason: Deligne weights; needs ℓ-adic cohomology with its six operations.

WeilConjectures.reason: Deligne's proof of the Riemann hypothesis over finite fields via étale cohomology.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/AdicSpaces.reason: Huber rings and adic spectra; Mathlib has valuations and topological rings but no adic spaces.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/AlgebraicCurves.reason: Function fields, divisors and Riemann–Roch; Mathlib has schemes but no divisor theory on curves.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/AnalyticToricGeom.reason: Toric varieties from fans with complex-analytic charts and comparison.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ArithmeticDirichl.reason: Dirichlet series and Tauberian theorems; Mathlib has L-series and Dirichlet's theorem.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/BelyiMaps.reason: Belyi's theorem and dessins; needs curves over number fields and étale covers.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/CFSGStatement.reason: Stating the classification needs groups of Lie type and the sporadic groups.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/Chebotarev.reason: Density of Frobenius classes; needs Artin L-functions or Deuring reduction beyond Dirichlet.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ClassFieldTheory.reason: Local and global reciprocity; needs Galois cohomology, ideles and Brauer groups.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/CombinatorialHeeg.reason: Grid homology of knots; combinatorial but needs knot diagrams and chain complexes over them.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ConformalMapping.reason: Riemann mapping theorem and boundary behaviour; Mathlib has holomorphic functions but not the mapping theorem.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/DGAInfinity.reason: DG and A-infinity algebras and modules over Mathlib's homological complexes.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/EllipticCurves.reason: Mathlib has Weierstrass curves and the group law; reduction, Mordell–Weil and Tate curves remain.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/Exchangeability.reason: De Finetti's theorem over Mathlib's measure-theoretic probability.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/FuchsianOrbifolds.reason: Fuchsian groups, quotient Riemann surfaces and orbifold points.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/GeometricTopology.reason: Solved Kirby-list problems in low-dimensional topology.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/GlobalNumberField.reason: Ray classes, adeles and Hecke characters on top of Mathlib's number fields and class groups.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/GlobalQuadraticFo.reason: Hasse–Minkowski and genus theory over number fields.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/GrothendieckEuler.reason: Exact structures, Grothendieck groups and Euler forms of finite-dimensional algebras.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/HeegaardFloer.reason: Analytic Heegaard Floer homology needs pseudo-holomorphic curve theory.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/HodgeStructures.reason: Pure, mixed and polarized Hodge structures and their geometric sources.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/HopfRinow.reason: Geodesics and the exponential map on Riemannian manifolds.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ModularCurves.reason: Katz–Mazur moduli of elliptic curves with Drinfeld level structure.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ModularForms.reason: Mathlib has modular forms and Eisenstein series; Hecke theory and newforms remain.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/NumberFieldArithm.reason: Ramification and Frobenius over Mathlib's Dedekind domains.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/OptimalTransport.reason: Kantorovich duality and Wasserstein geometry over Mathlib's measure theory.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/PDE.reason: Sobolev spaces and elliptic and evolution equations.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/PolynomialGaloisG.reason: Computing Galois groups of rational polynomials.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ProfiniteCohomolo.reason: Continuous cohomology of profinite groups beyond Mathlib's discrete group cohomology.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ProfiniteProPGrou.reason: Profinite and pro-p groups over Mathlib's profinite groups.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/QuadraticFormInva.reason: Witt groups and cohomological invariants of quadratic forms.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ReductiveGroups.reason: Reductive group schemes, tori and root data.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationThe.reason: Faithful finite-dimensional representations of Lie algebras.
Characters of finite groups over Mathlib's representation theory.
Finite-dimensional representations of the classical groups.
Peter–Weyl over Mathlib's Haar measure and compact operators.
Induction, restriction and Mackey theory for finite groups.
Lie groups and the Lie-algebra correspondence.
Highest-weight theory for semisimple Lie algebras.
Weyl groups and the Cartan–Killing classification over Mathlib's root systems.
Pin and Spin groups over Mathlib's Clifford algebras.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/StablePeriodicCur.reason: Stable categories, periodic complexes and matrix factorizations.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/StableReduction.reason: Stable reduction of curves and moduli of stable maps.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/UniversalCovers.reason: Universal covers over Mathlib's covering maps.
